title: Cheeni Kum
desc: Buddhadev, a 64-year-old chef, falls for Nina, 34. Their future is shaken when he learns her father is six years younger than him, casting doubt on their relationship.

title: Murder 2
desc: Arjun, a former cop, takes on the case of missing sex workers. To catch the culprit, young Reshma bravely steps in as bait-risking everything to expose the truth.

title: Phool Aur Kante
desc: Ajay, the son of a crime boss, lives peacefully until rivals kidnap his father. Forced into the underworld, he must confront danger and fight to save his family.

title: Haan Maine Bhi Pyar Kiya
desc: Shiv and Pooja's marriage crumbles after she uncovers his betrayal. As she rebuilds her life, a film star named Raj enters, bringing unexpected change and a chance at love.

title: Vicky Donor
desc: Vicky, a young man, becomes a sperm donor at Dr. Baldev's fertility clinic, leading to humorous and heartwarming events as he navigates unexpected responsibilities.

title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
desc: Kabir, Imran, and Arjun set off on a vacation in Spain before Kabir's wedding, where the journey helps them mend bonds, heal old wounds, embrace life, and face their deepest fears.

title: Tumbbad
desc: A family builds a shrine for Hastar, a dangerous monster. When they try to take his cursed treasure, scary things start happening, and their lives turn into a nightmare.

title: Bombay To Goa
desc: Mala, a young woman who witnesses a murder, flees on a Goa-bound bus. Along the way, she meets colourful travellers from different cultures and a spirited young man who refuses to leave her side.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Jeete Hai Shaan Se
desc: Friends Johny, Govinda, and Iqbal work to serve their community, but when tensions rise between Johny and Govinda, Iqbal intervenes before their greatest enemy exploits the rift.

title: Woh 7 Din
desc: After marrying Maya, Dr Anand discovers she loves another man. Heartbroken yet selfless, he sets out to find him and reunite the lovers against all odds.

title: Sikandar
desc: A young, driven rebel takes on a corrupt system, fighting for ordinary citizens' rights and shaking up the entrenched power structures of an unjust nation.

title: Kishen Kanhaiya
desc: Twin brothers Kishen and Kanhaiya, separated at birth-one rich, one poor-reunite years later to join forces and battle evil, proving blood ties conquer all odds.

title: Dil Chahta Hai
desc: Three inseparable friends drift apart after college-Akash moves to Australia, Sameer chases love, and Siddharth immerses in art-each following a different path.

title: Simmba
desc: Simmba, a corrupt cop, works for smuggler Durva. But when Durva's brothers assault a woman, Simmba changes sides and seeks justice, risking everything to make things right.

title: Dil Dhadakne Do
desc: Kamal and Neelam celebrate their 30th anniversary on a cruise, where family, friends, and unexpected lessons transform their lives and relationships forever.

title: Chintu Ka Birthday
desc: An immigrant family in Iraq faces chaos when soldiers storm their home during a birthday celebration, exposing them to the harsh realities of conflict and fear.
